question: Will Netanyahu's coalition lose its Knesset majority or dissolve early before 2026-10-27?
delta_reason: RESOLVE-NO. Both YES resolution paths are permanently exhausted as of July 17. Path 1 (roll-call majority loss): requires a functioning Knesset; the Knesset dissolved naturally July 17 — no roll-call vote is possible in a dissolved legislature. Path 2 (Netanyahu announces early dissolution, election moves earlier than Oct 27): the Knesset dissolved via mandatory statutory dissolution, not a Netanyahu-initiated early dissolution; October 27 is the mandatory date, not a moved-up date. Holding ACTIVE at p=0.15 through Oct 27 is a material misstatement — cadence rule governs p-updates, not resolution when YES conditions are structurally closed.
resolution_criteria: YES if a Knesset roll-call vote confirms coalition loss of majority (61 seats), OR if Netanyahu announces early dissolution and election date moves earlier than 2026-10-27. NO if coalition survives to mandatory election date with 61+ seats intact.
resolution_source_rule: Knesset official record + Reuters/Haaretz/Times of Israel. Polling alone does not resolve.
ambiguity_rule: If coalition drops below 61 but Netanyahu remains caretaker PM until election: YES. If a single party departs but coalition retains 61+: NO. Reviewed weekly only (Sundays); no intra-week deltas.
resolution_note: Both YES paths exhausted July 17. Path 1 closed by natural Knesset dissolution (no roll-call mechanism in dissolved Knesset). Path 2 closed because dissolution was mandatory (not early) and election date is Oct 27 (not moved earlier). Judge overrides Saturday cadence hold: cadence governs p-updates, not structural resolution.

question: Will Iran publicly commit to resuming mediated ceasefire negotiations (a named Iranian official or MFA announces readiness for talks) before EOD 2026-09-06?
delta_reason: RESOLVE-NO. Iran has made no public commitment to resuming mediated ceasefire negotiations. Pezeshkian's Sep 1 SCO conditional offer ('if US returns to MOU commitments, Iran will immediately reciprocate') is a conditional MOU reciprocity offer, not a public commitment to resuming mediated negotiations — resolved AMBIGUOUS-AS-NO per ambiguity_rule. FM Araghchi stated Aug 19 'Iran rejects ceasefire and demands a complete end to the war.' Iranian strikes continued Sep 2-3. VP Vance Sep 4: 'no talks with Tehran until it stops shooting at commercial shipping.' No mediator readout of any imminent session. Iranian state media (IRNA, Press TV, Tasnim, Fars) carried no official statement committing to talks in the Sep 3-5 window.
resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-09-06, a named Iranian official (FM Araghchi, SNSC, or IRNA/Tasnim/Press TV quoting an official) issues a public statement committing to resuming or entering mediated ceasefire negotiations with the United States. A 'readiness for talks' declaration counts; mere written-message relay does NOT count.
resolution_source_rule: One TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera) citing the named Iranian official, OR Iranian state media (IRNA/Tasnim) carrying the official statement.
ambiguity_rule: Conditional or preconditioned offers ('will talk if US stops strikes') = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO unless the US publicly accepts the condition; a mediator asserting Iran is 'open' without a named Iranian official statement = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.
resolution_note: Pezeshkian SCO Sep 1 offer resolved as AMBIGUOUS-AS-NO per rule (conditional, not a commitment; US did not publicly accept). Araghchi Aug 19 statement ('rejects ceasefire, demands complete end to war') is definitively NO. Iranian strikes Sep 2-3 and Vance Sep 4 'no talks' confirm no imminent session. No state-media acknowledgment of commitment to mediated talks in Sep 3-5 window.
